description: A huge, shaggy four-legged beast crouches and lunges toward the viewer. Its coat is a dense mat of rust-orange and dark brown fur, and its face is a hairless, angry red with glowing green eyes, a snarling mouth full of white teeth and two curved ivory tusks. It is framed close, head and shoulders filling the upper half, body angled to the viewer's left and seen from a little above, one heavy front paw near the bottom edge. Behind it is a flat pale grey floor where its dark grey shadow falls to the left. The light is flat and harsh; the mood is a bull-like threat about to charge. Frame 1: the front paw is lifted and pushed forward, held long. Frame 2: the paw slams down and a spray of dark dust kicks up, a brief flash. Frame 3: the paw drags back out of sight and a pale cloud of dust drifts behind it, held briefly. The loop reads as the beast slowly raising a paw, then scraping the ground in a quick stamp.
title: Tusked beast pawing the ground
